# Windows AD GPO Disabled

**Type:** TTP

**Author:** Dean Luxton

**Upstream version:** 6

## Description

This detection identifies when an Active Directory Group Policy is disabled using the Group Policy Management Console.

## MITRE ATT&CK

| ID | Technique | Tactics |
|---|---|---|
| [T1562.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/001/) | Disable or Modify Tools | defense-evasion |
| [T1484.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1484/001/) | Group Policy Modification | privilege-escalation, defense-evasion |

## Analytic Stories

- Sneaky Active Directory Persistence Tricks
